name: Ghost of Us
source: Welcome to The Ghost of Us – a heart-wrenching tale where corporate ambition collides with the mysteries of memory. Step into Rachel Rodriguez's world, a driven product manager whose deepest connection begins to unravel as she questions reality itself. Was Allan Yates, her brilliant engineer and closest confidant, ever real? Explore a story of professional triumphs, emotional bonds, and haunting revelations in this visually stunning mobile visual novel.
translation: 欢迎来到《我们的幽灵》——这是一个令人心碎的故事，企业的野心与记忆的奥秘发生了碰撞。走进雷切尔·罗德里格斯 (Rachel Rodriguez) 的世界，她是一位积极进取的产品经理，当她质疑现实本身时，她最深层的联系开始瓦解。她才华横溢的工程师和最亲密的知己艾伦·耶茨 (Allan Yates) 是真实存在的吗？在这部视觉震撼的移动视觉小说中探索职业胜利、情感纽带和令人难忘的启示的故事。
